cardBlurb: We visit the hotels, leasing offices and workplaces near you and build a referral network you can track.
intro: We visit the businesses around your restaurant or cafe, build relationships with their staff and turn them into a referral network you can track. Every stop and every sign-up shows up in your portal.
partnersIntro: Hotel guests, new neighbors, office teams and people out for the evening all ask the staff around them the same question: where should we eat?

treatExamples: Coffee and pastries for a hotel front desk's morning shift
Bagels and coffee for a leasing office team before the doors open
Snacks for a movie theater's evening box office crew
portalNote: In your portal you see every stop we make for your restaurant or cafe and every sign-up that comes through a partner's code, ready for your team to follow up. It's how you see which partnerships are working, business by business.

notes.title: A one-page partner agreement
notes.text: Every partner business signs a one-page agreement: mutual promotion, and nobody is paid per referral or per customer.

notes.title: No competing kitchens
notes.text: Our matching software leaves other restaurants, cafes, bakeries and bars off your route, and we skip any business you already work with unless you ask.

notes.title: Your menu, your words
notes.text: We describe your restaurant or cafe only in words you've approved, and we leave only the printed materials you've signed off on.

exclusivity: Partners agree to promote one restaurant or cafe like yours, and only yours, for as long as you are a client.

faq.q: Will you visit other restaurants or cafes near me?
faq.a: No. Our matching software ranks the businesses near you that share your customers and don't compete with you, so no other restaurants, cafes, bakeries or bars. You approve the list before we visit anyone.

faq.q: Most of my customers just walk in. What counts as a sign-up?
faq.a: Someone who taps a staff member's card or scans their code and fills in your sign-up form. Each one shows up in your portal with the business and staff member it came through, so your team can follow up and you can see which partnerships are working.

faq.q: Do I need to come along on the visits?
faq.a: No. Our field team makes every visit and logs every stop, and you see each one in your portal. Your part is approving the list of businesses and the words we use about your restaurant or cafe, and following up on the sign-ups that come in.
